QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_63

question.text: Performance Benchmarking for Category III AIFs must be done at what frequency per SEBI guidelines?

answer.text: Half-yearly, based on data as of September 30 and March 31

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 231, Box 6.2 says performance benchmarking shall be done half-yearly, based on data as of September 30 and March 31 each year. Page 230 references the related SEBI circular framework. The Trap: Monthly, quarterly, and annual-only cadences do not match the SEBI-prescribed September 30 / March 31 half-yearly schedule. Note: The cut-off dates are fixed by Box 6.2; the cadence does not vary by fund category or strategy within Category III AIFs.
